test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the marks of a student from 5 different subjects in 2018 and 2019. Find the ratio of total marks of 2018 to the total marks of 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/756a459acc0f4ce73ebdf15e286bbb1498ac9a7cb6928fba1ef8d9fec27f296c.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total marks of 2018 = 33 + 60 + 70 + 55 + 46 = 264

Total marks of 2019 = 68 + 35 + 40 + 45 + 20 = 208

Total marks of 2018 : Total marks of 2019 = 264 : 208

⇒ 33 : 26

**∴ The correct answer is 33 : 26.**
